column1: # [OLD / DEPRECATED] This deterministic hard-counter FAILED after decks were
# scaled to 21+ cards and action choice became stochastic (temp 2): it can no
# longer reliably assemble its combo each turn. Kept for reference only.
# Found by search. Mid/Low volume pressure (8 Mid + 7 Low attack
# break) against the zones where superguard has only ONE super each
# FIVE Mid blocks so its guard-break Mid/High offence is soaked by sheer volume
# rather than by supers. Out-tempos the slow control shell.
